description: Read a trail's timeline. Everything that happened on the trail, newest first: created, plans approved, questions asked and answered (on the trail and on its items), runs, items filed and done, pull requests opened, approved and merged, every rollout step, pull-back and autopilot action, the goal watch…

before.description: ISO-8601 time; only events strictly before it (the `next` of the previous page).

handle.description: The trail's handle (`T-12`) or its id.

limit.description: Most events to return (1-200). Defaults to 50.

name: trails_timeline
